turns.speaker: Sheku Koroma
turns.question: Turn the research into a clear launch position. Use only sources updated this month.

segments.text: Your strongest position is not “another AI workspace.” It is a governed thinking environment where teams can trace every answer back to its source
, reuse what works, and see the cost of a decision before it lands

blocks.text: “Cortex turns scattered expertise into trusted, repeatable playbooks — with citations and cost controls built in.”
blocks.attribution: Proposed one-liner. Not sourced; it summarises 1–5.

segments.text: Every claim stays attached to evidence
, every useful response can become a team pattern
, and every model decision stays inside a visible budget

turns.speaker: Sheku Koroma
turns.question: What gives that position credibility with enterprise buyers?

segments.text: Enterprise teams do not need another promise of accuracy. They need to see where an answer came from
and who is allowed to change it
. In practice that means three things the buyer can check for themselves:

items.text: Each claim opens the passage it came from.
Roles, retention and audit history pass a security review
Spend is capped per answer, not reconciled at month end.
